description: r5:F1 — DELICIOUS EATING SQUIGS after the healed unit has MOVED. 01.02.03: a revived model is set up in coherency with models of its unit that started the phase on the battlefield; before the fix it came back where it died, 4" behind its unit, out of coherency (the End-of-Turn check then removed it). Setup-only: Kult of Speed; the Kommandos (one model destroyed) stand 4.9" from the Rukkatrukk Squigbuggies in the open bottom-left corner. The player clicks the Kommandos, selects all (Ctrl+A), drags them 4" towards the buggies and locks the move in — the destroyed model stays where it died. S panel -> DELICIOUS EATING SQUIGS -> pick the buggies: a confirmation shows the revived Kommando's auto-placed set-up spot (ring on the board) and spends nothing; Cancel leaves the model destroyed and the CP unspent. Use again -> Confirm: 1 CP is spent and the Kommando is revived with 1 wound at the marked spot next to its moved unit, the whole unit coherent, overlapping no model.

steps.comment: setup privilege: Kult of Speed; Kommandos (last model destroyed) 4.9" from the buggies — not yet within 3"
WP-O6: the Kommandos' codex Found 'Em! is offered when they are selected to move — not under test, declined
WP-O6: Found 'Em! / Bomb Squig may be offered again at the end of the Kommandos' normal move — not under test, declined

steps.script:
var ko: Array = GameState.state.units["U_KOMMANDOS_A"].models
return float(ko[0].position.y) > 2100.0 and float(ko[ko.size() - 1].position.y) < 1910.0
